scripts.dev: node init && concurrently -n "BACKEND,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:client: node init && npm run dev --prefix client
scripts.dev:backend: node init && npm run dev --prefix backend
scripts.build:client: node init && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.build:backend: node init && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.build: node init && npm run build:backend && npm run build:client
